title: Layerre
one_liner: The API for automating Canva designs
description: Turn existing Canva designs into dynamic templates you can drive from an API or a no-code UI.--Auto-generate ads, social posts, banners, and other variants from one template with text and image overrides.--Integrates with Make, Zapier, and n8n so teams can plug Layerre into existing workflows.--Supports batch production with consistent exports (PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF) for high-volume creative.--Built end-to-end: Playwright automation against Canva, a React/TypeScript product UI, and a Python-backed API.
